headline: The things your toddler does that are just you, only smaller
items: Sighing like you do when the coffee's gone cold
On the toy phone, saying 'mm-hmm, mm-hmm' with your exact face
Patting the dog twice on the head on the way out, like you do
Saying 'okaaay' in the voice you use when you've given up
turn: You're being studied. Lovingly, and all day long.
